Publisher, subscriber, attached source state and replica ported in process. MutableReplicatedState is backed by a Tracker: Change(context, Action<Draft>) (plus a Func<Draft, object?> overload that rejects returned tasks) publishes the prepared compact ops with rollback, reentrancy and async rejection; Replace adopts the value through prepareReplace and publishes [["r", value]] as upstream does. A per-state change gate serializes mutations across threads (see the file header). Tests: chord.state.* (state.test.ts, state-delivery.test.ts), chord.state.value.* (state-value.test.ts), chord.state.draft.* (state-draft.test.ts), chord.state.diff.* (state-diff.test.ts), chord.state.fuzz.converges-across-randomized-prepared-revisions (state-fuzz.test.ts), chord.state.native.*
Internal interface instead of a WeakMap. Tests: chord.state.* (exact listeners and snapshots)
